articles.title: Soldier recounts terrorist attack: "I felt a bullet hit my helmet and lowered my head"
articles.description: A soldier who participated in the exchange of fire with the terrorists at Yehuda Junction described the moments of the encounter, the bullet that struck his helmet, and his attempt to calm a fellow soldier.
